title_original: Software giant SAP confirms cyber incident amid reports of source code breach
description: German software giant SAP confirmed a cybersecurity incident following reports that hackers infiltrated its software development infrastructure, potentially gaining access to the company’s source code.

title_original: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
